adminOverviewIntro: Build themed paths from stations, and stations from modules. Only admins see drafts.
adminNewPathHint: A new path starts as a draft and stays hidden until you publish it.
adminOrphanStationsHint: These stations don't belong to any themed path. Open them and choose a path so they appear again.
adminPathPublishedHint: Visitors see the path with all published stations.
adminPathDraftHint: Only visible here. Publish the path once its stations are ready.
adminFirstStationHint: A template sets up the flow right away – add texts and pictures afterwards.
adminTemplateIntro: For “{path}”. Pick a flow as a template – every module can be changed, moved or removed later.
adminDraftRestored: Your unsaved changes are still here.
adminLongDescriptionHint: Shown on the station page before the station starts.
adminModulesIntro: Modules play one after another when the station starts.
adminAddFirstModuleHint: Story text, before/after, quiz, audio story and more.
adminRemoveModuleText: The module “{name}” and its content will be removed from the station. Nothing is saved until you save the station.
adminModuleLibraryIntro: Pick a format – adjust content and settings afterwards.
adminModuleOnlyOnce: This module can only be used once per station.
adminLocationIntro: Tap the map or drag the golden marker. The path's other stations are shown numbered.
adminMapEditLabel: Map – tap to set the station's location
adminErrorLocation: Please set the location on the map.
adminPublishedOnHint: The station appears in the app once its path is published.
adminArModuleHint: The AR look-around only works on a phone on site.
adminDeleteStationText: “{name}” will be deleted permanently, including all pictures and recordings.
adminPreviewCaption: Live preview – tap the top bar to switch modules
adminPreviewEmpty: Add a module to see the preview.
adminPreviewIncomplete: The preview appears once the first content is in place.
adminPreviewArPanorama: The AR look-around only runs on a phone on site.
